items.title: Kimberly Clark (KMB) Completes Kenvue Acquisition
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark (NasdaqGS:KMB) has closed its acquisition of Kenvue, bringing the consumer health business under its corporate umbrella. The board has been restructured, with new directors appointed and amended corporate by-laws adopted alongside the Kenvue deal. Kimberly-Clark has named a new Chief Marketing Officer as it starts the process of integrating Kenvue into its operations.
